story.title: About <accent>Us</accent>
story.heading: How We Started?
story.paragraph1: Founded in 2004, 1st Forex has been a trusted name in the forex trading industry for over two decades. Based in Costa Rica, we specialize in providing top-notch forex education and reliable trading signals, empowering traders worldwide to achieve their financial goals.
story.paragraph2: Through our 1st Forex Academy, we have trained thousands of happy students and traders via online courses and in-person seminars, constantly refining our curriculum to remain one of the best in the world. Our track record speaks for itself, with countless success stories from those who have trusted us to guide their trading journey.
story.paragraph3: Our team blends experienced forex veterans, successful traders, and product specialists. Together, we focus on practical education, disciplined signals, and tools traders can actually use.
story.paragraph4: From structured signals to platform tools available on our mobile app and user-friendly website, we help clients make clearer trading decisions.
story.paragraph5: At 1st Forex, we don’t just see clients—we see family. We are passionate about what we do, and we are dedicated to building a thriving, connected community where traders of all levels can learn, grow, and succeed.

about.title: About Us
about.paragraph1: Founded in Montreal over 20 years ago, 1st Forex has grown into a global company focused on forex education and trading signals. What started as in-person seminars and early online signals has developed into a trusted platform used by thousands of traders worldwide.
about.paragraph2: A key part of our work is our Breakout Strategy, a proven trading method designed to spot strong market moves early. This strategy is at the core of our signals and education, helping traders make more consistent and informed decisions.
about.paragraph3: Now based in Costa Rica, our goal remains the same: to help traders build confidence, improve their skills, and work toward financial independence in the forex market.
about.paragraph4: Leading 1st Forex is our CEO, Marie Josée Bergeron, who has over 22 years of experience in forex trading. Her vision of building a strong trading company and real trader community has shaped everything we do.
about.paragraph5: She is supported by a skilled team of traders and product specialists who help keep our strategies, signals, and platform clear, modern, and effective.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.paragraph1: Our mission is simple yet powerful: Empowering Your Trading Journey. We aim to inspire and guide traders at every stage, helping them navigate the complexities of the forex market with confidence and skill.
mission.paragraph2: Join the 1st Forex family and be part of a legacy where passion meets precision, and tradition meets innovation. Together, we’ll turn dreams into financial independence and trading mastery.

1.question: What is the difference between a demo account and a live account?
1.answer: A demo account uses virtual funds, so you can practice in a simulated market environment without risking real money. A live account uses real funds deposited with your broker, so profits and losses directly affect your account balance.
1.subDescription: We strongly recommend becoming comfortable with the platform and the signals on a demo account before trading with real funds.

2.question: Where do I download MetaTrader 5 (MT5)?
2.answer: MT5 can be downloaded directly from your broker's website, usually under a section called Downloads, Platforms, or Trading Platforms.
2.subDescription: Once MT5 is installed, log in with the account credentials provided by your broker. If you need help connecting your account, our support team can guide you.

3.question: How do I know which broker is best for me?
3.answer: The best broker depends on your country of residence, funding preferences, and trading needs. We list selected brokers that offer competitive spreads, reliable execution, and user-friendly platforms.
3.subDescription: TMGM is commonly recommended because of its ease of use, funding options, and client feedback. Every broker listed on the platform has been selected because it meets our standards for quality and reliability.

4.question: What if I am located in the United States?
4.answer: Forex and CFD trading regulations in the United States differ from many other countries, and several international brokers do not accept U.S. residents.
4.subDescription: For U.S.-based traders, brokers such as OANDA and Forex.com may be more suitable because they operate within U.S. regulatory requirements.

5.question: Where can I find the broker links?
5.answer: Recommended broker links are available in the Getting Started section of your dashboard.

points.3: Additional resources to help you get started

6.question: What are trading signals?
6.answer: Trading signals are trade ideas generated through proprietary analysis and market research.

points.3: Trade direction, such as buy or sell

6.subDescription: Members can choose whether or not to take any signal. All trading decisions remain the responsibility of the individual trader.

7.question: Are trading signals guaranteed to be profitable?
7.answer: No. Financial markets involve risk, and no trading strategy or signal service can guarantee profits.
7.subDescription: We aim to provide high-quality analysis and trade opportunities, but all trading carries the possibility of loss.

8.question: How do I fund my trading account?
8.answer: Funding options vary depending on the broker you choose. Most recommended brokers offer several deposit methods.

points.2: Cryptocurrency, such as USDT, where available
points.3: Local payment methods, depending on your country

8.subDescription: To view the funding methods available to you, log in to your broker's client portal after opening your account. Available options differ by broker and region.

9.question: How much money do I need to start?
9.answer: The minimum deposit varies by broker. Many recommended brokers allow accounts to be opened with relatively small deposits.
9.subDescription: We recommend starting with an amount you are comfortable risking and focusing on proper risk management rather than account size.

10.question: Can I copy trades automatically?
10.answer: No. When you receive a signal, you must manually enter the trade information into MT5, including the entry price, stop loss, and take profit.

11.question: What markets do your signals cover?
11.answer: Our signals primarily focus on major forex pairs. Market coverage may expand based on available opportunities and market conditions.

12.question: What time are signals sent?
12.answer: Signals are sent whenever qualifying opportunities are identified by the analysis team. There is no fixed schedule because market conditions determine when trades are taken.
12.subDescription: Signals are available from market open on Sunday at 5 PM EST through Friday at 5 PM EST. Notifications are delivered through the platform and connected communication channels.

13.question: Do I need prior trading experience?
13.answer: No. The platform is designed for both beginners and experienced traders.
13.subDescription: New traders can start with the education resources and demo accounts, while experienced traders can use the signals and market analysis right away.

14.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
14.answer: You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your account dashboard.
14.subDescription: Access to premium services remains active until the end of your current billing period.

15.question: Can I use my phone to trade?
15.answer: Yes. MT5 is available for both iOS and Android devices. You can monitor trades, receive signals, and manage positions directly from your smartphone or tablet.

16.question: Do you manage client funds?
16.answer: No. 1stForex does not accept deposits or manage client funds.
16.subDescription: All trading accounts are held directly with the broker you choose. You remain in full control of your account and trading decisions at all times.
